name: Draw an aquarium
desc:
🎨 Draw your own fish and bring it to life!

Draw any fish you can imagine, give it eyes and a name, then roll to see how rare it is: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic or even SECRET, with a chance of a Gold, Diamond or Rainbow mutation!

🐠 Your fish swim in your own aquarium and earn money every second
⭐ Draw better for more stars: size, colours, detail, eyes and neatness all count
💰 Upgrade your tank to fit more fish, and your luck to roll rarer ones
🪸 Decorate your tank with decorations that boost your money

Can you draw a SECRET fish? 🐟

llm.loop: draw a fish -> roll its rarity and mutation -> fish swim in your aquarium earning $/s -> upgrade tank and luck -> draw more
llm.objectives: draw a SECRET fish and grow aquarium income
llm.progression: rarity tiers, mutations, tank capacity, luck upgrades, decorations
llm.instructions: draw any fish, name it, roll for rarity; better drawing gives more stars
unique: player-drawn creatures as income units with drawing-quality scoring
llm.thumbnails: crayon fish, Mona Lisa fish 'MY MASTERPIECE', 'I DREW THIS?!', frozen vs molten
llm.complexity_notes: drawing canvas with scoring of the drawing, fish rendering from drawing
